state.text:
Route the customer message to exactly one department: billing, technical, sales, or other.
Examples:
I was charged twice for the same invoice. -> billing
Please update the billing address on our account. -> billing
I need a refund for last month. -> billing
The API returns 500 errors on upload. -> technical
Our webhook stopped receiving events after a deploy. -> technical
Duplicate events appear when retries are enabled. -> technical
Can I get a quote for 50 seats? -> sales
I want to schedule a demo of the enterprise plan. -> sales
How do your plans compare? -> sales
Are you hiring remote engineers? -> other
I need your press kit for an article. -> other
How do I submit feedback or a complaint? -> other
